title: What does your intuition notice first?
intro: Rate a few everyday experiences to create a simple reflection profile.
disclaimer: For entertainment and self-reflection only. This is not a psychological assessment or diagnosis.
questions: I notice recurring patterns in ordinary events.
I can name how a situation feels in my body.
I sense when it is time to pause or act.
I pick up on the mood of a room.
I trust myself to check a first impression.
I notice meaningful timing without treating it as proof.
I can listen while keeping healthy boundaries.
